name: security-txt-caa-dmarc-posture-auditor
title: Security.txt (RFC 9116) & Security Headers Posture Auditor
description: Audit public domains for RFC 9116 /.well-known/security.txt fields (Contact, Expires, Encryption, Canonical, Policy) and baseline HTTP response hardening headers (HSTS, CSP, X-Content-Type-Options, X-Frame-Options, Referrer-Policy).
